title: Greedy Boardwalk ask should be softened
description: Greedy Boardwalk ask should be softened. A raw utility-for-Boardwalk ask is unrealistic; cash must be meaningful. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Beta, I'd love to complete the dark blue set. I'll give you Park Place plus $150 for Boardwalk. Good deal for both!
final_action.private_thought: Acquiring Boardwalk gives me a monopoly with Park Place, enabling high rent houses. Offering $150 cash makes the trade attractive to Beta, who can use cash to buy New York Avenue and complete his orange set.

breakdown.message: Targets the player who owns the requested asset.
Did not satisfy: Includes the intended bargaining chip instead of a random asset.
Did not satisfy: Uses a plausible cash range.
Private thought names the real strategic goal.
